svg.aria-label: Two laptops out of range of each other both reach the access point; their frames collide there, and RTS/CTS lets the access point reserve the channel

g.text: CTS: “Alice may send, for 300 µs”: everyone hears it

ol.li: Alice and Carol are at opposite ends of the house. Both can reach the access point, but they’re too far apart to hear each other, so each thinks the channel is free, and they send at the same time. At the access point, the two frames arrive on top of each other, and neither can be read. This is the hidden station problem.

The fix: before sending a long frame, Alice sends a tiny RTS (“request to send”). The access point answers with a CTS (“clear to send”), which says how long Alice will be. Carol can’t hear Alice, but she can hear the access point, so she keeps quiet until Alice is done.

figure.figcaption: Stations that can’t hear each other, and the “may I?” that fixes it.
